metaDescription: Order custom orange workwear in bulk for high-visibility safety. Perfect for construction crews, traffic control, and outdoor workers. Get a quote today.
introHtml: Orange workwear is the standard for high-visibility safety in construction, traffic management, and outdoor industries. From ANSI Class 2 mesh vests to UPF-rated safety tees, orange gear ensures your team stays seen on the job. Customize with reflective stripes, logos, or screen-printed company names to meet safety regulations while reinforcing your brand. Whether you need lightweight summer options or insulated hooded sweatshirts, orange workwear combines compliance with comfort for long shifts.
